name: Michael
description: The greatest of the archangels and Captain of the Lord's Host, a Seraph with Divine Might 100 who leads the battle against the Devil and taught the Ars Notoria to Solomon.

name: Gabriel
description: Archangel of Prophecy and chief messenger of God, who announced the incarnation to the Virgin Mary and brought the Qur'an to Muhammad; Divine Might 100 (Mentem).

name: Raphael
description: Best loved of angels ('God has healed'), Regent of the Sun, head of the guardian angels and of the Cherubim Choir, who protects humanity and heals the sick.

name: Uriel
description: The 'fire (or light) of God', a Seraph and Archangel of the Presence, Patron of Prophecy and Angel of Punishment who watches over the torments of Hell; removed from the Western Church's list by Pope Zachary in 745.

name: Israfel
description: Seraph and Angel of the Trumpet and of Last Judgement, who will end the world by blowing his trumpet in Jerusalem; recognised as an archangel in Islam.

name: Azrael
description: The Archangel of Death, chief angel of death and strongest of the angels, who extracts the souls of prophets and of the Islamic dead; Divine Might 90 and a poisoned long spear.

name: Metatron
description: Once the patriarch Enoch, now the angel of the Face of the Lord, King of Angels and Chancellor of Heaven, a being of living flame with 36 pairs of wings.

name: Chamuel
description: An archangel listed by Dionysus the Areopagite among the archangels.

name: Zadkiel
description: An archangel listed by Dionysus the Areopagite among the archangels.

name: Jophiel
description: An archangel listed by Dionysus the Areopagite among the archangels.

name: Zerachiel
description: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

name: Remiel
description: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

name: Satqiel
description: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

name: Baraqiel
description: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

name: Sidriel
description: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

name: Anafiel
description: An angel counted among the three largest beings in existence, alongside Metatron and Sandalphon.

name: Sandalphon
description: One of the three largest beings in existence, who carries the prayers of the faithful to Heaven; his tears fell to earth when Muhammad died.

name: Tears of Sandalphon
description: Two powerful divine relics, tears shed by Sandalphon at the death of Muhammad, sought by an angel and by a diabolical coven wishing to use them as arcane connections.

name: Seferiel
description: An archangel with an interest in the occult and magical arts who follows the actions of Hermetic magi.

name: Asuryal
description: Asuryal, Herald of Deliverance, a Principality (Divine Might 10) who guards the domain of a mundane lord disguised as a minor advisor.

name: Camuel
description: Camuel the Dark Angel, a Throne who wrestled with Jacob; once an archangel, he was reduced after trying to prevent Moses receiving the Torah and now mediates prayers of the faithful.

name: Eiael
description: Eiael, Aid to the Wise, an angel (Divine Might 20) tasked with guarding lovers of wisdom who pursue magical arts; he teaches practitioners of Ars Notoria and may be summoned via Psalm 36.

name: Harut and Marut
description: The angels who, as revealed in the Qur'an, revealed the magical arts to humanity to test the faithful.

name: Kolazonta
description: Kolazonta the Chastiser, an angel of Divine Might 30 (Ignem) serving Uriel, who brought plague upon the rebellious Israelites and was defeated by Aaron.

name: Midael
description: Midael, Captain of the Celestial Army, a Potentate under Michael who defends those persecuted by evil men, often appearing as a knight.

name: Munkar
description: One of the two Questioners, Throne angels who examine the Muslim dead in their graves about Muhammad and punish unbelievers.

name: Nakir
description: One of the two Questioners, Throne angels who examine the Muslim dead in their graves about Muhammad and punish unbelievers.

name: Nasir
description: Nasir the Helper, a minor angel charged with the safety of pious travellers, appearing as an unassuming man in travelling clothes.

name: Samuil
description: Samuil, Angelic Guide, a Cherub who with Raguel transported Enoch through the Seven Heavens and now delivers visions to saints and prophets.

name: Raguel
description: An angel who, together with Samuil, transported Enoch through the Seven Heavens.

name: Dionysus the Areopagite
description: Authority who lists the archangels as Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Uriel, Chamuel, Zadkiel and Jophiel.

name: Elijah
description: Patriarch who almost destroyed the archangel Azrael.

name: Pope Zachary
description: Pope who removed Uriel from the list of angels recognized by the Western Church in 745.

name: Solomon
description: King who received the Ars Notoria from the archangel Michael; the Rings of Solomon and Temple of Solomon bear his name.

name: Moses
description: Patriarch who received the Torah, made the brazen serpent Nehushtan, and whose body Michael defended from Satan.

name: Aaron
description: Moses' brother who, armed with a censer, defeated the fiery angel Kolazonta.

name: Jacob
description: Patriarch who wrestled through the night with an angel, identified as Camuel.

name: David
description: King who invoked the angel Midael in Psalms 34 and 35.

name: Noah
description: Patriarch warned of the Flood by Uriel.

name: Daniel
description: Prophet taught by Gabriel; the Book of Daniel names Michael as a chief prince.

name: Muhammad
description: The Prophet of Islam, to whom Gabriel brought the Qur'an; at his death Sandalphon wept.

name: Virgin Mary
description: The Blessed Virgin, to whom Gabriel announced the incarnation of Christ; more honored than Michael.

name: Jesus
description: Christ, visited by Camuel and Gabriel in the Garden of Gethsemane.

name: Lucifer
description: The rebellious angel thrown into Hell by St. Michael, who took his place as chief of the princes of Heaven.

name: Anti-Christ
description: The foe against whom Michael will lead the angelic charge at Armageddon.

name: Adam
description: First man, whom Michael was first to obey God's command to worship.

name: Balaam
description: Figure to whom Michael appeared (Numbers 22).

name: St. Paul
description: Apostle whom Samuil may have taken to the Heavens.

name: Usama ibn Munqidh
description: Author (d. 1188) of The Book of Learning by Example, who recounts aid from an angel.

name: Mansur
description: The Muslim emir of Semita Errabunda, used as an example of invoking God's aid in combat.

name: Semita Errabunda
description: Covenant whose emir Mansur appears in the example of invoking God's aid.

name: al-Kamil
description: Sultan of Egypt, invested by the 'Abbasid caliph, with Magic Resistance 10 from the commanding aura.

name: al-Nasir
description: The 'Abbasid caliph who invested al-Kamil as sultan.

name: Henry I of Cyprus
description: Crowned king of Cyprus who carries a fragment of the True Cross, for a total Magic Resistance of 30.

name: Saint Ursmar
description: Saint whose relics were placed on the church floor at Blaringhem in 1060 to plead for mercy.

name: Hugh
description: Local lord at Blaringhem moved by Saint Ursmar's relics to pardon a murderer.

name: John the Baptist
description: Precursor to Jesus (Yahya in Islam), beheaded by King Herod; several churches claim his head.

name: King Herod
description: King who beheaded John the Baptist at Salome's request.

name: Salome
description: Herod's daughter at whose request John the Baptist was beheaded.

name: King Hezekiah
description: King who broke Nehushtan into pieces during his fight against paganism.

name: Archangel
description: The Host of Archangels, ruling angels of the Choirs and Heaven's vanguard; Divine Glory manifest who will war against Hell on Judgment Day.

name: Angel
description: Messengers of God and caretakers of humanity, the ninth Angelic Hierarchy; every living soul has its own guardian angel.

name: Grigori
description: The Watchers, the tenth Choir who stayed neutral in the War in Heaven, were cast to Earth, bred with mortals and now wander as masters of lore, trapped in their Mantles.

name: Seraphim
description: Angelic Choir to which Israfel, Uriel and Michael belong.

name: Cherubim
description: Angelic Choir of Raphael and Samuil.

name: Thrones
description: Angelic Choir of Camuel, Munkar and Nakir; pious kings are placed among them.

name: Principalities
description: Angelic Choir to which Asuryal belongs; pious kings are placed among them.

name: Potentates
description: Angelic Choir to which Midael belongs.

name: Guardian Angel
description: Angel assigned to each soul, communicating through Envisioning; also a power granting +5 Soak and Magic Resistance 15.

name: Nephilim
description: The angel-blooded great heroes of the Antediluvian Age.

name: Old Ones
description: Pagan gods which some magi believe to be transformed Grigori.

name: Faerie
description: Supernatural beings whose magic is weakened in the Dominion and against whom God's aid may be invoked.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings to whom relics are anathema; some Grigori are believed to have become devils.

name: Angelic Choirs
description: The nine (or ten) orders of angels in the Heavenly Hierarchy, sometimes equated with hierarchies in mortal society.

name: Angelic Mantle
description: The physical form an angel wears to appear as a normal human; Grigori are permanently trapped in theirs.

name: Envisioning
description: The splendorous visionary manifestation through which angels, especially guardian angels, communicate.

name: Merkavah
description: A means by which angels may be summoned and spoken with.

name: Seven Heavens
description: The seven Heavens presided over by the seven ruling archangels, through which Enoch was transported.

name: Heaven
description: The abode of God and the angelic host.

name: Hell
description: The realm of torment to which the fallen were cast and over which Uriel watches.

name: War in Heaven
description: The rebellion in Heaven during which the Grigori remained neutral.

name: Judgment Day
description: The Last Judgement, when archangels will war against Hell and Israfel will sound his trumpet.

name: Divine Might
description: The Might score of Divine beings and relics, used to fuel powers and acting as Magic Resistance.

name: Divine Realm
description: The Realm of God, to which holy characters, angels and relics are aligned.

name: Infernal Realm
description: The Realm of Hell and demons, against which relics and angels are especially potent.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine aura, which holy characters can temper and in which faerie magic is weakened.

name: Holy Characters
description: Blessed people possessing powers and backgrounds aligned with the Divine realm.

name: Holy Methods
description: Supernatural Abilities (Invocation, Meditation, Purity) used with Holy Powers to work miracles.

name: Holy Powers
description: Supernatural Abilities (Adjuration, Blessing, Cursing, Intervention, Transcendence, Understanding, Wonders) producing miraculous effects.

name: Miraculous Effects
description: The rules for effects produced by holy Methods and Powers.

name: Faith Points
description: Points from True Faith or relics usable as Confidence and granting Magic Resistance.

name: Divine Warping
description: Warping resulting from holy powers and Divine exposure.

name: Divine Ascent
description: Temporarily becoming part of the Divine Realm, a risk reduced by Meditation.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural distortion; those Raised from the Dead accrue Warping points yearly.

name: Holy Influence
description: The ability of holy characters to instill Personality Traits in followers via personal or ceremonial influence (die + Presence + Leadership).

name: Personal Influence
description: Holy influence exerted by spending a season setting a good example for followers.

name: Ceremonial Influence
description: Holy influence exerted through a short ceremony and prayer costing a Faith or Confidence point.

name: Spiritual Authority
description: Being invested with responsibility for others' spiritual well being, required for holy influence.

name: Temper
description: A particular aspect of the divine invoked into a Dominion aura as a Personality Trait, aiding compatible acts and hindering opposed ones.

name: Loyal Temper
description: Temper of loyalty and faithfulness, tied to Faith and opposing the vice of Pride.

name: Calm Temper
description: Temper of tolerance and peace, tied to Hope and opposing the sin of Wrath.

name: Kind Temper
description: Temper of love and mercy, tied to Charity and opposing Envy.

name: Brave Temper
description: Temper of courage, tied to the cardinal virtue Courage and opposing Sloth.

name: Wise Temper
description: Temper of reason over base desire, tied to Prudence and opposing Lust.

name: Strong Temper
description: Temper of self-control, tied to Temperance and opposing Gluttony.

name: Just Temper
description: Temper of fairness, tied to Justice and opposing Avarice.

name: Pride
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Wrath
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Envy
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Sloth
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Lust
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Gluttony
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Avarice
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Schism
description: The state of an aura bearing multiple opposing tempers, canceling each other; in 1220 Iberia, Southern France, Byzantium and the Holy Land are in schism.

name: Invoking God's Aid
description: Uttering a prayer and spending a Confidence or Faith point to gain a Divine Aid bonus (stress die + Communication + Dominion Lore).

name: Divine Aid Bonus
description: Bonus of up to +3 to rolls furthering an objective, gained by invoking God's aid.

name: Commanding Aura
description: Divinely granted Magic Resistance, Soak bonus and an Aura of Rightful Authority effect held by invested religious and secular leaders.

name: Relics
description: Physical remains or objects of holy figures with Faith scores and Divine Might, venerated especially in Christianity.

name: Brandea
description: Containers and wrappings of original relics, themselves imbued with sanctity.

name: Humiliation of Relics
description: Practice of physically humbling relics to prompt a saint's action or persuade the laity to piety.

name: Scourging the Infernal
description: Common relic power radiating an aura that repels and damages Infernal creatures.

name: Cult of Saints
description: Christian veneration of saints in which relics play an important part.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to supernatural effects, granted by Might, Faith, relics or the commanding aura.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural area aura; Divine auras can be tempered.

name: Regio
description: Supernatural region level which Samuil can traverse freely.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power held in pawns in the bodies of angels and beings.

name: Lunar Sphere
description: Celestial boundary beyond which Samuil can transport the devout.

name: Trained Group
description: Group combat rule to which Divine Aid bonuses are added.

name: Holy War
description: Religiously sanctioned warfare; God's aid may be invoked only against infidels or heretics.

name: Antediluvian Age
description: The age before the Flood, era of the Nephilim.

name: Confidence
description: Points spent to invoke God's aid or holy methods.

name: Personality Traits
description: Character traits that holy characters can inspire and that map to tempers and vices.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: A magician outside the Order; Holy Magic users carry a reputation as one.

name: Grog
description: Supporting character type who cannot take Blood of the Nephilim or invoke God's aid.

name: Magus
description: Hermetic magician; magi cannot take Blood of the Nephilim.

name: Focus Character
description: The participant in a Ceremony who possesses the Ability and resolves the effect.

name: Holy Magic
description: Major Hermetic Virtue for Gifted characters replacing Magic Theory with the Supernatural Ability Holy Magic, adapting spells to a divine focus.

name: Adjuration
description: Major Supernatural Power Virtue to command and control supernatural beings; grants Adjuration 1.

name: Blessing
description: Major Supernatural Power Virtue invoking protective and inspirational aspects of the Divine; grants Blessing 1.

name: Ceremony
description: Minor Supernatural Ability Virtue focusing a group in holy prayer; grants Ceremony 1.

name: Cursing
description: Major Supernatural Power Virtue to curse those opposing the Divine Will; grants Cursing 1.

name: Intervention
description: Major Supernatural Power Virtue granting Intervention 1 for signs and wonders.

name: Invocation
description: Major Supernatural Method Virtue granting Invocation 1, allowing stress dice for miraculous effects.

name: Meditation
description: Major Supernatural Method Virtue granting Meditation 1 to gain insight into the Divine.

name: Blood of the Nephilim
description: Major Supernatural Virtue: angelic blood from the Nephilim, increased size, extremely slow aging, vast appetite.

name: Powerful Relic
description: Major General Virtue: owning a relic with Faith score 3 and one power.

name: Purity
description: Major Supernatural Method Virtue granting Purity 1 for strenuous miraculous rituals.

name: Strong Angelic Heritage
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue requiring Blood of the Nephilim; grants Divine Might (Corpus) and holy powers.

name: Transcendence
description: Major Supernatural Power Virtue to overcome physical limitations; grants Transcendence 1.

name: Understanding
description: Major Supernatural Power Virtue to glean the Divine plan; grants Understanding 1.

name: Wonders
description: Major Supernatural Power Virtue to conjure holy items, creatures and elements; grants Wonders 1.

name: Inspirational
description: Virtue allowing ceremonial influence on anyone willing to listen.

name: Mythic Companion
description: Virtue making one's Nephilim heritage undiluted.

name: Arcane Lore
description: Minor Virtue normally needed to learn Dominion Lore at creation.

name: Relic
description: Minor General Virtue granting a relic.

name: True Faith
description: Major General Virtue granting Faith Points; required for Eremite and Non-traditional.

name: The Gift
description: Magical talent required for Holy Magic.

name: Giant Blood
description: Virtue incompatible with Blood of the Nephilim.

name: Faerie Blood
description: Virtue incompatible with Blood of the Nephilim.

name: Temporal Influence
description: Virtue allowing personal influence over those in temporal authority.

name: Enduring Constitution
description: Virtue possessed by Camuel.

name: Tough
description: Virtue possessed by Camuel.

name: Piercing Gaze
description: Virtue possessed by Azrael, Munkar and Nakir.

name: Good Teacher
description: Virtue possessed by Gabriel.

name: Greater Immunity
description: Virtue granting immunity (to Fire) held by Kolazonta and Michael.

name: Entrancement
description: Supernatural Virtue/Ability held by Michael.

name: Animal Ken
description: Supernatural Virtue/Ability held by Michael and Nasir.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Virtue/Ability held by Nasir.

name: Ways of the (Local Environment)
description: Virtue held by Nasir.

name: Raised from the Dead
description: Major Story/Supernatural Flaw: resurrected by a miracle, accruing Warping every year.

name: Eremite
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: exploring the divine alone, unable to learn Supernatural Abilities from any tradition; requires True Faith.

name: Non-traditional
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: belonging to no holy tradition, with no favored Abilities; requires True Faith.

name: Apostate
description: Minor General Flaw: converted faith, with bad reputation 4 among the former faith.

name: Greedy
description: Minor Personality Flaw imposed by Blood of the Nephilim.

name: Age Quickly
description: Flaw incompatible with Blood of the Nephilim.

name: Lycanthrope
description: Flaw incompatible with Blood of the Nephilim.

name: Low Self-Esteem
description: Major General Flaw preventing invocation of God's aid.

name: Long-winded
description: Flaw held by Camuel.

name: Adjuration
description: Supernatural Ability to control and banish supernatural creatures and their powers.

name: Blessing
description: Supernatural Ability bringing beneficial or protective divine effects.

name: Ceremony
description: Supernatural Ability letting a group combine holy efforts, with a leader or group modifier.

name: Cursing
description: Supernatural Ability bringing negative effects of God's wrath.

name: Holy Magic
description: Supernatural/Arcane Ability translating Hermetic Arts into magic compatible with the Dominion.

name: Intervention
description: Supernatural Ability causing the divine to manifest physically.

name: Invocation
description: Holy Method using holy words and prayers, adding Communication and allowing stress dice.

name: Meditation
description: Holy Method achieving an ecstatic state, adding Intelligence + Meditation.

name: Purity
description: Holy Method using strenuous physical effort and extended rituals.

name: Transcendence
description: Supernatural Ability bringing miraculous changes to mind and body.

name: Understanding
description: Supernatural Ability granting holy visions of guidance.

name: Wonders
description: Supernatural Ability making creatures, objects and natural forces manifest.

name: Dominion Lore
description: Arcane lore of the Divine, used to invoke God's aid.

name: Ars Notoria
description: Holy art of learning received by Solomon from Michael, taught by Eiael.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic Ability not learned by Holy Magic users.

name: Theology
description: Knowledge of religious doctrine.

name: Leadership
description: Ability used in holy influence and tempering auras.

name: Magic Lore
description: Lore of magic and magicians.

name: Infernal Lore
description: Lore of Hell and devils.

name: Church Lore
description: Lore of the Church and saints.

name: Israel Lore
description: Area lore of Israel.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability of the liberal arts.

name: Civil and Canon Law
description: Academic Ability of law.

name: Philosophiae
description: Academic Ability of philosophy.

name: Medicine
description: Academic Ability of healing.

name: Chirurgy
description: Ability of binding wounds.

name: Concentration
description: Ability to maintain focus.

name: Penetration
description: Ability to overcome Magic Resistance.

name: Awareness
description: Ability of alertness.

name: Brawl
description: Unarmed combat Ability.

name: Charm
description: Ability to make a good impression.

name: Etiquette
description: Ability of courtly manners.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability to understand people.

name: Guile
description: Ability to lie and detect lies.

name: Intrigue
description: Ability of political scheming.

name: Single Weapon
description: Martial Ability with one-handed weapons.

name: Great Weapon
description: Martial Ability with two-handed weapons.

name: Thrown Weapon
description: Martial Ability with thrown weapons.

name: Hunt
description: Ability of tracking.

name: Teaching
description: Ability of instruction.

name: Athletics
description: Ability of physical exertion.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability with animals.

name: Swim
description: Ability of swimming.

name: Music
description: Ability of performing music.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Art (Form) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Art (Form) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Art (Form) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Art (Form) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Art (Form) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Art (Form) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Art (Form) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art (Form) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Art (Technique) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Art (Technique) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art (Technique) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Art (Technique) used to classify angelic powers and vis.

name: Curse of the Unportended Plague
description: Hermetic spell duplicated by Kolazonta's Chastise the Sinful power.

name: Enchantment of Detachment
description: Hermetic spell whose effect Michael duplicates to bring order.

name: Panic of the Trembling Heart
description: Hermetic spell whose effect Michael duplicates to create chaos in mortal hearts.

name: Pilum of Fire
description: Hermetic spell duplicated by Michael's Heavenly Fire at +30 damage.

name: Incantation of Lightning
description: Hermetic spell duplicated by Michael's Heavenly Lance.

name: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: Hermetic spell duplicated by Michael's Smite Evil.

name: Confusion of the Numbed Will
description: Hermetic spell duplicated by Midael's Confound the Wicked.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority
description: ReMe 20 Hermetic spell whose effect the commanding aura duplicates.

name: Divine Guidance
description: Angel power modifying Personality Trait rolls toward virtue.

name: Heavenly Servant
description: Angel power doubling traits against Infernal beings.

name: Spirit Form
description: Angelic power to become pure spirit, immune to physical effects.

name: Subtle Form
description: Angelic power to appear as any human.

name: Grant Longevity
description: Eiael's power to remove Aging Points.

name: Revoke Gifts
description: Eiael's power to revoke any Ring of Solomon.

name: Impart Wisdom
description: Eiael's power to teach Ars Notoria at Source Quality 13.

name: Enlighten
description: Gabriel's power to implant Knowledge.

name: Chastise the Sinful
description: Kolazonta's plague power.

name: Question
description: Munkar and Nakir's power compelling truthful answers.

name: Comfort the Righteous
description: Camuel's power alleviating doubt and fear.

name: Unrelenting Struggle
description: Camuel's power to fight all night without Fatigue.

name: Smite Evil
description: Michael's power as Demon's Eternal Oblivion, also affecting Faeries.

name: Celestial Immunity
description: Saintly miracle used by Michael and Midael.

name: Infallible Guide
description: Samuil's power to traverse any regio.

name: Transport the Devout
description: Samuil's power to carry a person anywhere, even beyond the Lunar Sphere.

name: Mass Healing
description: Saint Power held by Nehushtan.

name: Resist Temptation
description: Saint Power of the Head of John the Baptist.

name: The Faithful Made Whole
description: Saint Power of the Head of John the Baptist.

name: Ark of the Covenant
description: Relic built to carry the tablets of the Law, lost since 587 BC; Faith 10 for Jews and Divine Might 100.

name: Head of John the Baptist
description: Relic claimed by churches in Amiens, Constantinople and Damascus; Faith 5, Divine Might 50.

name: Nehushtan
description: The brazen serpent of Moses that healed all who looked upon it, broken by Hezekiah; if reassembled it would have Mass Healing.

name: True Cross
description: Relic of which Henry I of Cyprus carries a fragment with 2 Faith Points.

name: Holy Lance
description: Relic named among those venerated by the monotheistic faiths.

name: Prophet's Seal Ring
description: Relic named among those venerated by the monotheistic faiths.

name: Ring of Solomon
description: Stages of Ars Notoria; Eiael guides practitioners at the Fourth Ring and may revoke them.

name: Jerusalem
description: Holy city where Israfel will blow his trumpet, contested by Christians and Muslims.

name: Garden of Gethsemane
description: Where Camuel and Gabriel visited Jesus.

name: Watchtowers of the World
description: Places where St. Michael watches for attacks on the City of God.

name: City of God
description: Heavenly city guarded by St. Michael.

name: Gates of Hell
description: Guarded by St. Michael.

name: River Nile
description: River protected by St. Michael.

name: Iberia
description: Region in schism due to the Reconquista.

name: Southern France
description: Region in schism after the Albigensian Crusade.

name: Byzantium
description: Region in schism between Eastern and Western churches.

name: Holy Land
description: Region contested by Christians and Muslims.

name: Constantinople
description: City conquered by the Fourth Crusade in 1204; claims the head of John the Baptist.

name: Nicaea
description: Seat of a claimant to the Byzantine Empire.

name: Trebizond
description: Seat of a claimant to the Byzantine Empire.

name: Epirus
description: Seat of a claimant to the Byzantine Empire.

name: Georgia
description: Eastern Christian state.

name: Armenia
description: Eastern Christian state.

name: Baghdad
description: Seat of the 'Abbasid caliph and the exilarch.

name: Egypt
description: Sultanate of al-Kamil.

name: Cyprus
description: Kingdom of Henry I.

name: Blaringhem
description: Town in Flanders where Saint Ursmar's relics were humiliated in 1060.

name: Flanders
description: Region containing Blaringhem.

name: Amiens
description: French city claiming the head of John the Baptist.

name: Damascus
description: Syrian city claiming the head of John the Baptist.

name: Temple of Solomon
description: Temple whose Holy of Holies housed the Ark of the Covenant.

name: Babylon
description: Power whose troops took Jerusalem in 587 BC.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Hermetic Order, in which Holy Magic users have a poor reputation as hedge wizards.

name: Western Church
description: The Latin Christian Church, headed by the Pope (Magic Resistance 25).

name: Greek Orthodox Church
description: Eastern church whose patriarchs have Magic Resistance 20.

name: Byzantine Empire
description: Empire whose emperor headed the Greek Orthodox Church until 1204.

name: 'Abbasid Caliphate
description: Religious authority in Baghdad whose caliph has Magic Resistance 25.

name: Almohad Caliphate
description: Rival caliphate whose caliph has Magic Resistance 25.

name: Fourth Crusade
